title: KuaYue instance pack configuration
description: Validates <game-dir>/kuayue/config.json. A missing file or object without packs uses runtime defaults.

enabled.description: Requested optional pack switches. Built-in presets default to true and external packs default to false. Required built-in packs are enabled by the runtime and must not appear here.

order.description: Normal optional-pack resource priority from lowest to highest. Required built-in packs are fixed at the lowest priority and must not appear here.

inventory.description: Derived list of installed external pack IDs. Built-in presets are omitted.

$comment: Missing configs enable all optional built-in presets. Required built-ins are enabled automatically and are excluded from enabled and order. The game rewrites inventory from installed external pack IDs only. order is low priority to high priority.
